summary: ECARX Holdings Inc. (via its Chinese subsidiaries) filed a 6-K reporting a definitive Equity Purchase Agreement dated June 18, 2026, to acquire the entire equity of Hubei Qiguang Technology Co., Ltd., which operates the Flyme software business. The buyer is Ecarx (Hubei) Ecological Investment Co., Ltd.; sellers are three affiliates of Xingji Meizu Group. Financial terms (price, premium) are not disclosed in the excerpt; the agreement includes customary closing conditions, pre- and post-closing covenants, and termination provisions. The acquisition is expected to provide ECARX end-to-end OS capabilities. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. Watch for regulatory clearance in China and completion timeline.
